# Steam — localized store description

- Original source: [Steam — localized store description](https://store.steampowered.com/app/46560?l=spanish)
- Author / publication: Steam / Microids publisher listing
- Language / date: Spanish storefront; also inspected Portuguese listings
- Access: Indexed product text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The store identifies Spellbound as developer, Microids as publisher, and app ID 46560. It describes single-player play, over thirty missions, nine characters, varied mission types, mouse-driven combat, and changing atmospheric conditions.

The interface language table lists English, French, German, and Spanish. The [Portuguese storefront](https://store.steampowered.com/app/46560/Robin_Hood_The_Legend_of_Sherwood/?l=portuguese) translates marketing text while explicitly marking Portuguese game support unavailable. Store-page language therefore is not evidence of a game localization.

Publisher-selected review endorsements point to ActionTrip, GameSpy, and GameZone. They are discovery leads, not substitutes for reading those original reviews.

**Limitations:** the listing's 1 November 2002 date differs from other release databases. Historical system requirements and GPU exclusions may describe an older package. No purchase or installation was performed.
